title: Chapter 306: Annihilation Of Wagner'S Unit
content:
Chapter 306: Annihilation Of Wagner'S Unit

Soon, Wang Shuo led his troops to intercept Wagner.

Wagner was not an undead knight, so the warhorse under his crotch was only used for traveling. It had no speed bonus and was much slower than Wang Shuo's three legions.

"Wagner, surrender!" Wang Shuo stood proudly with the Bloodthirsty Spear in his hand.

"Do you think you can beat me?"

Wagner pretended to be calm when he saw that his way was blocked.

The momentum must be controlled.

Wang Shuo did not say anything more.

"Look at the gun."

Both sides immediately launched an attack.

Wang Shuo had a deep understanding of the difficulty of killing top generals.

Gong Zheng, Ayub and other fierce generals of the Chiyan Army surrounded him.

Soon, Li Jianguo's crossbow battalion rushed over and immediately set up a bronze crossbow cart in the distance.

Wang Shuo and his men immediately understood and released several control skills.

Dozens of bronze spears flew over.

Wagner died on the spot in the northwest.

Su Xiu, who was fighting hard on the battlefield, was simply unbelievable when he saw Wang Shuo kill a top general so easily.

At this moment, his long-standing sense of superiority was shattered.

Seeing how skillfully they cooperated, it seemed that this was not the first time.

He kicked the skeleton in front of him and felt a little uncomfortable.

Wang Shuo quickly picked up the dropped items and showed a happy look on his face.

Because there was a certificate of job transfer for a high-level general among them.

At this time, the battlefield was in chaos. After Wang Shuo put away the items, he started chasing again.

Another half an hour, not a single skeleton escaped.

"Lord Wang, you have made great contributions to the victory of this battle!"

"Not bad, not bad, Mayor Wang led the troops and was invincible. He is really a role model for our generation!"

"In this battle, if Mayor Wang had not broken the defense of the pass, I am afraid that we would not be able to attack even if we sacrificed our lives!"

Wang Shuo was very pleased to see his allies constantly flattering him.

Who doesn't like such praise!

But he was not overwhelmed by the victory in front of him.

Because rescuing Changping County, this is the first step.

"Everyone, the small victory in front of us is not worth celebrating. There is still a fierce battle waiting for us later!"

"Lord Wang is right."

Hearing this, everyone's face changed. Thinking that they were about to face a general, as well as a large number of senior generals and tens of thousands of skeletons, they felt a headache.

"There is no time to lose, let's set off immediately! I'm afraid that if we go too late, Changping County will be gone."

Saving others is saving yourself!

Changping County must be saved.

After everyone left a small number of people to clean up the battlefield, the main force immediately headed for the east gate of Changping County.

At this time, the city wall of Changping County had been breached, and the undead army was killing into the city.

Lin Xiaodong put on armor and went into battle with a group of confidants, struggling to deal with the bloodthirsty demon wolf.

Most of the defensive arrow towers in the city were destroyed, and the residents were slaughtered by the undead.

They only need corpses, not living people.

Wang Shuo and others saw this and did not hesitate.

They quickly joined the battle.

The strength of these skeletons is all above level 50, and it is quite difficult to kill them.

Several knights of the Hell Knights must cooperate with each other to kill them.

Fortunately, the three-headed dog is more adaptable to the terrain than the golden fire cavalry, and its combat effectiveness is still strong.

As for the other cavalry units, they can basically only be used as infantry.

Wang Shuo quickly captured a section of the city wall.

Li Jianguo immediately arranged troops to set up bronze crossbow carts on the city wall.

Wang Shuo sincerely thanked the boss who exploded the bronze crossbow cart.

If it weren't for it, he would never have been so smooth.
